comparison.objective: Insert a stripped cable into a lug, actuate a crimping press, and return the finished cable; candidate commissions a hydraulic damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires bimanual cable alignment and depth control while pressing a lever. Candidate requires recessed hex insertion, captive-screw torque, fine collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, and repeated test adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a depth- and angle-correct crimp, lever release, cable extraction/return, and arm clearance; its simulated hold is event-based and not pull-tested. Candidate requires physically retained adjustment and two force-, travel-, energy-, rebound-, and drift-compliant cycles.
comparison.reason: Both include guarded machine actuation, but cable insertion/crimping and dynamic damper tuning are materially different tested abilities.
